tasks.name: export-ffi-link-time-impl
tasks.scopedGoal:
Implement the v0.3 Export + callback registration + link-time extern surface end-to-end inside the compiler submodule. All work lands on the `orch/beskid-v0-3/export-ffi-link-time` branch. Deliver:

## 1. `[Export]` attribute lowering (codegen + AOT)

- Recognize `[Export(Abi:"C", Symbol:"...")]` on `pub` `HirFunctionDefinition` items inside `compiler/crates/beskid_codegen/src/lowering/lowerable.rs` and `compiler/crates/beskid_codegen/src/lowering/function.rs`. Reuse the existing `attributes: Vec<Spanned<HirAttribute>>` on `HirFunctionDefinition`; extend the `HirAttribute` walker to read string-literal `Abi` / `Symbol` arguments (touch only the codegen-side accessor; the HIR shape itself is read-only).
- Add `compiler/crates/beskid_codegen/src/lowering/expressions/export.rs` exporting a `read_export_metadata(def) -> Option<ExportEntry>` helper plus the `ExportEntry { beskid_name: String, exported_symbol: String, abi: String }` type. Validate the function signature against the same FFI scalar allowlist used by `validate_ffi_signature` in `cranelift_host.rs` (re-use, do not duplicate). On invalid signature emit a structured `CodegenError`.
- Add a `pub exports: Vec<ExportEntry>` field to `CodegenArtifact` in `compiler/crates/beskid_codegen/src/lowering/context.rs` and populate it from `lower_program` in `lowerable.rs`. Update `compiler/crates/beskid_codegen/src/module_emission.rs` if a sibling helper is needed.
- In `compiler/crates/beskid_codegen/src/lowering/expressions/extern_call.rs` (new), centralise the extern-call lowering currently inlined elsewhere if needed for clarity, or leave it as a thin re-export module if the existing path already covers it. Do **not** rewrite working extern lowering; only refactor enough to expose the call site for export-symbol parity tests.

## 2. AOT export table + link-time `external_libraries`

- Add `compiler/crates/beskid_aot/src/export_table.rs` (new module exported from `compiler/crates/beskid_aot/src/lib.rs`) that owns:
  - `pub struct ExportTable { entries: Vec<ExportTableEntry> }` consuming `CodegenArtifact::exports`.
  - `pub struct ExportTableEntry { beskid_name: String, exported_symbol: String, abi: String }`.
  - `pub fn from_artifact(artifact: &CodegenArtifact) -> ExportTable` plus helpers to resolve the linker-visible symbol list for a given `ExportPolicy`.
- Extend `compiler/crates/beskid_aot/src/api.rs` `AotBuildRequest` with a new `pub external_libraries: Vec<String>` field (default empty in `with_defaults`). Document semantics: each entry is a logical library name (`"c"`, `"m"`, …) passed as `-l<name>` to the host linker; consumed only by `link_stage`. Validate that any `ExternImport.library` present in the artifact has a matching `external_libraries` entry (or the project `link` block, see §3) and emit a structured `AotError::UnresolvedExternLibrary { library: String, symbol: String }` otherwise.
- Update `compiler/crates/beskid_aot/src/linker.rs` so `link()` appends `-l<library>` for each entry in `external_libraries` (Linux/macOS) and `<lib>.lib` (Windows). When `ExportPolicy::Explicit(...)` includes Export symbols, ensure the version script / `-Wl,-exported_symbol` list contains them.
- Update `compiler/crates/beskid_aot/src/object_module.rs` so AOT-declared user functions tagged as Export use `Linkage::Export` (current code already does this for all user functions; keep behaviour and document why so the export table parity test passes).
- Re-export `ExportTable`, `ExportTableEntry`, `AotError::UnresolvedExternLibrary` from `compiler/crates/beskid_aot/src/lib.rs`.

## 3. Project `link` block integration (consumer side)

- **Do not** add/modify `compiler/crates/beskid_analysis/src/projects/` (owned by sibling `foreign-lib-import-cli` task). The model already has (or will land) `ProjectLinkSection { libraries: Vec<String>, search_paths: Vec<String>, extra_args: Vec<String> }` (currently a WIP stash in another branch).
- Plumb the link block through `beskid_engine` (your `src/**` is allowed): when an engine consumer builds an `AotBuildRequest` from a `CompilePlan`, copy `compile_plan.manifest.link.libraries` into `AotBuildRequest.external_libraries` (and propagate `search_paths` to a new `AotBuildRequest.library_search_paths`). If the project model field doesn't exist yet on `main` (stash unresolved), gate the read with `if let Some(link) = &manifest.link { ... }` and fall back to empty — the impl must not break compilation when foreign-lib hasn't merged.
- Add a helper in `beskid_engine` (e.g. `compiler/crates/beskid_engine/src/link_libraries.rs` or extend `engine.rs`) that builds the `external_libraries` Vec from extern imports + manifest link block, with a stable resolution order: explicit manifest libraries first, then auto-discovered `ExternImport.library` strings.

## 4. Callback registration table + GC-safe trampoline (runtime + ABI)

- Add `compiler/crates/beskid_runtime/src/builtins/callback.rs` (new file) exporting `#[unsafe(no_mangle)] pub extern "C-unwind" fn beskid_register_callbacks(version: u32, table: *const CallbackTableEntry, count: usize) -> i32` and a host-side `CallbackTableEntry { symbol_id: u32, fn_ptr: *const u8, userdata: *mut std::ffi::c_void }` `#[repr(C)]` struct. The registration MUST:
  - Reject `version != BESKID_USER_FFI_LAYOUT_BAND` with a non-zero stable error code (use 1).
  - Reject null / zero-count tables with a non-zero stable error code (use 2).
  - Store entries in a process-global table guarded by `OnceLock<Mutex<...>>` (no per-thread state).
- Add the GC-safe trampoline helper: an inline function (or macro) that wraps a `[Export]` callback so that, before invoking Beskid code, it calls `enter_runtime_scope()` and installs the heap/root TLS, then runs the body, then leaves the scope. The trampoline must be re-entrant safe; documented in module rustdoc. Expose `pub fn install_callback_trampoline(beskid_fn_ptr: *const u8) -> *const u8` returning a stable trampoline pointer keyed by the Beskid pointer.
- Wire the new module from `compiler/crates/beskid_runtime/src/builtins/mod.rs` and re-export the public surface from `compiler/crates/beskid_runtime/src/lib.rs`.
- Add to `compiler/crates/beskid_abi/src/symbols.rs`:
  - `pub const SYM_BESKID_REGISTER_CALLBACKS: &str = "beskid_register_callbacks";`
  - `pub const BESKID_USER_FFI_LAYOUT_BAND: u32 = 1;` (initial Standard band).
  - Append `SYM_BESKID_REGISTER_CALLBACKS` to `RUNTIME_EXPORT_SYMBOLS`.
- Add a matching entry in `compiler/crates/beskid_abi/src/builtins.rs` `BUILTIN_SPECS` so codegen can declare it as an import on the module.
- Optionally extend `compiler/crates/beskid_runtime/src/interop/` with a host-callback dispatch table (mirroring `dispatch_table.rs`) keyed by `symbol_id`; keep changes additive.

## 5. Un-ignore the three engine tests and add interop integration tests

- Rewrite `compiler/crates/beskid_engine/tests/ffi_v03_link_time.rs` to remove `#[ignore = "v0.3 FFI impl ..."]` and assert real behaviour:
  - `link_time_extern_getpid_matches_platform_spec`: Build an AOT object that imports `getpid` via `[Extern(Abi:"C", Library:"libc")]`, pass `external_libraries: vec!["c".into()]` in the `AotBuildRequest`, link to an executable, exec it on Linux, and assert exit code matches the running process's `getpid()`. Linux-only (`#![cfg(target_os = "linux")]`).
  - `export_plugin_init_visible_to_linker`: Build a `BuildOutputKind::SharedLib` from a Beskid source with `[Export(Abi:"C", Symbol:"beskid_plugin_init")]`, then either (a) run `nm -D` on the produced `.so` and assert the symbol is present (`T beskid_plugin_init`), or (b) `dlopen` + `dlsym` it from the test and call it. Linux-only.
  - `host_registers_callbacks_with_layout_band`: From the runtime side, construct a `CallbackTableEntry` array, call `beskid_register_callbacks(BESKID_USER_FFI_LAYOUT_BAND, table.as_ptr(), table.len())`, assert it returns 0; then call it with `version = BESKID_USER_FFI_LAYOUT_BAND - 1` and assert it returns 1. Linux-only is fine since the rest of the file is `#![cfg(target_os = "linux")]`.
- Add `compiler/crates/beskid_tests/src/interop/export.rs` and `compiler/crates/beskid_tests/src/interop/callback.rs` (new files, wired through `compiler/crates/beskid_tests/src/interop/mod.rs`). Tests should be platform-portable where possible: assert `CodegenArtifact::exports` is populated correctly, assert `ExportTable::from_artifact` produces the expected entries, assert `BESKID_USER_FFI_LAYOUT_BAND` is exported by `beskid_abi`, assert `SYM_BESKID_REGISTER_CALLBACKS` is in `RUNTIME_EXPORT_SYMBOLS`.
- Tweak `compiler/crates/beskid_tests/src/analysis/ffi_v03_spec.rs` only as needed to cover the new analysis-level rules (e.g. `[Export]` on a non-`pub` function emits a diagnostic). Add at most 1-2 small tests; do not refactor the existing ones.

## Constraints

- Stay strictly inside the parent track `pathsAllowed`. Do **not** touch `composition_policy.rs`, `composition/**`, `extern_call.rs`/`export.rs` outside the listed paths, `mod_host/**`, `beskid_cli/src/commands/**`, `abfall/**`, `composition/**`, or corelib `Collections`/`System` paths.
- Do **not** modify `compiler/crates/beskid_analysis/src/projects/**` (foreign-lib's domain). Read-only consumption of the `link` block is fine via `beskid_engine`.
- Linux tier-1 is the conformance target. macOS/Windows tests should be `#[cfg]`-gated and may be skipped (`#![cfg(target_os = "linux")]`) where the C host link path doesn't yet work on those hosts.
- Phase A single-mutator: callback trampolines must enter `enter_runtime_scope()` and install heap/root TLS before invoking Beskid code; never allocate from a non-runtime-scoped thread.
- ABI symbol additions must land in `beskid_abi::BUILTIN_SPECS` and be re-exported through `beskid_runtime::lib`, otherwise link errors surface late in `beskid_engine`.
- Do not change `BESKID_RUNTIME_ABI_VERSION`; the new `BESKID_USER_FFI_LAYOUT_BAND` is the user-facing FFI band and is independent.
- Run `cargo check -p beskid_codegen -p beskid_aot -p beskid_runtime -p beskid_abi -p beskid_engine -p beskid_tests` from `compiler/` before handing off to the verifier.
